name: accordion
title: Accordion
description: Collapsible sections whose content is measured, so any height springs open smoothly — with a rotating chevron, fade-and-drop content, single or multiple mode, and default, bordered or separated-card styles.
summary: Sections spring open to their measured height while the chevron turns.
usage:
import { Accordion, AccordionItem } from '@/components/ui/accordion';

<Accordion defaultValue={['shipping']}>
  <AccordionItem value="shipping" title="How long does shipping take?">
    Orders leave our warehouse within 24 hours.
  </AccordionItem>
  <AccordionItem value="returns" title="Can I return an item?">
    You have 30 days to send anything back for a full refund.
  </AccordionItem>
</Accordion>
behavior: Tap a header to open or close its section. In single mode, opening one closes the other; disabled items don't respond.
Content height springs to its measured size, so any content animates smoothly. The chevron turns 180° on the native driver.
Each header is a button with expanded and disabled state. Content of closed sections is hidden from assistive tech.
props: One open item at a time, or any number.
Called when items open or close.
Single mode: allow closing the open item.
Divided list, one bordered box, or separate cards.
Identifies the item in the Accordion's value array.
Leading icon; content indents to line up with the title.
Style for the Accordion's root view (the card in the bordered variant); AccordionItem takes its own.
